changelog: New screen: Admin → Cron Jobs. Every background task in the system is now listed in one place with its schedule, last run, result, next run and an on/off switch.
The server now needs only ONE cron line — * * * * * php cron/run.php. It ticks every minute and the app decides what is due. The old four cron entries still work but can be removed.
Run any job by hand with the play button, or press Run all due now. Retry failed re-runs everything whose last run failed.
Health panel: shows whether the cron is running, late or stopped, with ticks so far, runs and failures in the last 24 hours and average duration. It refreshes itself every 30 seconds.
Execution log on the same page plus a full, filterable history by job and status.
Each job's schedule can be changed from the panel — every N minutes, or once a day at a set time.
A run that dies mid-flight leaves a lock; the panel shows it and gives you a Clear lock button.
Two ticks can never run the same job twice — each job is claimed with a database lock before it starts.
Hosting with no shell cron can call tick.php with a generated key instead.
